project.title: Hybridization-capture sequencing for SARS-CoV-2 variant estimation in wastewater genomic surveillance
project.description: This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of a hybridization-capture sequencing approach for wastewater genomic surveillance. Hybridization-capture sequencing was applied to wastewater samples to obtain single-nucleotide variant (SNV) frequencies across the whole SARS-CoV-2 genome. We refined an iterative matrix reduction (IMR) algorithm to estimate the relative abundance of SARS-CoV-2 lineages based on these SNV frequencies from whole-genome sequence data.
project.center_name: Faculty of Geosciences and Civil Engineering, Kanazawa University
